title: Launch HN: Runtime (YC P26) – Sandboxed coding agents for everyone on a team
summary: Runtime is a YC-backed startup building infrastructure to let entire teams (including non-engineers) use coding agents like Claude Code and Codex without engineering bottlenecks. After successfully shipping 4 products in 3 months using agents personally, the founder discovered that rolling out the workflow to the rest of the team resulted in unmergeable code and constant engineering handholding.
problem_solved: Enables non-engineers to effectively use AI coding agents while maintaining code quality and mergeability across an entire team.
why_valuable: Solves the critical scaling problem of AI coding agents - moving from individual productivity to team-wide adoption without engineering becoming the bottleneck.
